verdicts.reason: A is broken. Both dog illustrations, one circle and the arrow shapes are shrunk to tiny icons and jammed in a row in the bottom-left corner. The other circle floats alone on the right with no dog in it, and most of the canvas is empty, so the key imagery is lost. B is close to the original: dogs in circles on both sides and the headline in the centre. The only flaw is that the arrow shapes run into the top and bottom edges and sit a little tight on the text.
